objectives: Identify Esau and his nation as the class teaches it.
Describe where Esau dwelt and the prophecies over Edom and Teman.
takeaways: These are the generations of Esau, who is Edom; the class identifies Edom with the people called the white man today.
Esau came out red and hairy, and was named Edom, red, for the red pottage.
Esau dwelt in mount Seir, the clefts of the rock, whose pride hath deceived him (Obadiah 1:3).
The wise men of Edom and the mighty men of Teman shall be destroyed (Obadiah 1:8-9).
Kings reigned in Edom before any king reigned over Israel.
